benefit_note: Proceeds, not profit. The gain on this tranche is proceeds minus its share of cost basis (about a quarter of NIS 940M), roughly NIS 0.8B, before fees and allocation to limited partners.
methodology: Paid to Affinity by the buyers (Fidelity among them), not by Phoenix. The edge is drawn to Phoenix for readability. Approximate gain on the tranche: 1.05B - (0.25 x 0.94B) ≈ NIS 0.815B, an estimate that assumes pro-rata cost basis.

benefit_note: A point-in-time market value that moves with Phoenix's share price. Unrealized.

title: Reported total gain on the Phoenix investment
benefit_note: As reported, a mix of realized gain (T-006 tranche) and unrealized appreciation (T-007). Classified as unrealized because most of it is.
methodology: Consistency check: T-006 (1.05B) + T-007 (3.3B) - T-005 (0.94B) = NIS 3.41B, matching the reported NIS 3.4B.
